chunks: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the Quran being made easy for dhikr?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the divine ease of the Quran's guidance, contrasting with the complexity of those who obscure it, and underscores the necessity of active reflection (tadabbur) for spiritual growth. It serves as a foundational proof for the accessibility of revelation to all believers, not just the elite, inviting sincere contemplation to internalize its lessons.
